hero.title: Your next concert, better with company
hero.subtitle: Connect with people who vibrate on your same musical frequency. Stop going alone, start experiencing music together.

features.discovery_desc: It's not luck, it's rhythmic science. We use your Spotify history to create real connections based on what you actually listen to.
features.threshold_desc: Guaranteed quality. You only unlock social features after 100 interactions to ensure authentic and committed profiles.
features.events_desc: All your local billboard in one place. Direct sync with Ticketmaster so you never miss a beat.

integrations.title: Technological Power
integrations.subtitle: Robust stack driven by leading APIs and .NET 9 architecture.
integrations.spotify_desc: Deep connection with Spotify API to extract your musical DNA (BPM, energy, and genres) without you having to type a single word.
integrations.ticketmaster_desc: Real-time sync with Ticketmaster to offer you a live billboard. Buy your tickets and coordinate with your group in one place.

values.title: Our Values
values.connection_desc: We build real bonds between fans using verified listening signals, not empty profiles. Every match starts from music compatibility based on real usage data.
values.diversity_desc: We celebrate mixed genres, scenes, and styles to unlock new discovery paths. We recommend connections that expand your musical world without losing affinity.
values.experience_desc: We turn the lead-up and the concert into a shared experience with collective energy. From match to venue, we aim for every encounter to feel alive and memorable.

footer.tagline: Don't miss the beat, don't go alone.
